config:
# Rotation seed 1 at 9B, for the variance of the headline settings (N = 4, phi = 1/2, 3 and 4
# bits, rotated, scaled and unscaled). Every other run uses seed 0; comparing seed0 (from
# scaling-9b), seed1 and seed2 shows which differences of a few hundredths are real.
name = "seed1-9b"
output = "results/seed1-9b"

[model]
path = "Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base"

[eval]
window = 2048

[grid]
bits = [3, 4]
group_sizes = [64]
children = [4]
phases = [0.5]
rotation = [true]
scaling = [false, true]
seed = 1
max_missing = 1
rtn_bits = [3, 4]
